segments.text: Look, I see you're a pretty sharp pipette, so I'll give it to you straight.
segments.zh: 听着，我看你是根挺机灵的移液管，所以我就跟你直说了。

segments.text: As much as we try to get things right, free of accidents, chances are something's gonna
segments.zh: 尽管我们尽力把事情做对、避免事故，但很可能在某个时候还是会

segments.text: go wrong at some point, so you gotta be prepared for the worst.
segments.zh: 出问题，所以你得做好最坏的准备。

segments.text: Automated early warning systems are ideal.
segments.zh: 自动化的早期预警系统是最理想的。

segments.text: These puppies are gonna monitor for things like carbon monoxide, smoke and excess heat,
segments.zh: 这些小家伙会监测一氧化碳、烟雾和过热之类的情况，

segments.text: and the permissible exposure limit and threshold limit values for really whatever substance
segments.zh: 还有你所使用的几乎任何物质的允许暴露限值

segments.text: you're working with.
segments.zh: 和阈限值。

segments.text: Your lab ventilation system should typically be running continuously with several full
segments.zh: 你们实验室的通风系统一般应该连续运行，每小时进行好几次

segments.text: air changes every hour.
segments.zh: 全面换气。

segments.text: You can't just rely on fume hoods for exhaust.
segments.zh: 你不能只靠通风柜来排风。

segments.text: Look, I could talk all day about emergency response, but I ain't got all day, so let
segments.zh: 听着，关于应急响应我可以讲上一整天，但我可没有一整天的时间，所以

segments.text: me just point you to four key resources you can't go without.
segments.zh: 我就给你指出四样你离不开的关键资源吧。

segments.text: Safety Data Sheets.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书。

segments.text: This is the fourth time I've mentioned those.
segments.zh: 这已经是我第四次提到它们了。

segments.text: You could practically live in those things, they've got it all.
segments.zh: 你几乎可以住在那里面了，里面什么都有。

segments.text: Then you've got your operational plans.
segments.zh: 然后是你们的操作计划。

segments.text: These include things like the chemical hygiene plan and the exposure control plan.
segments.zh: 这些包括化学品卫生计划和暴露控制计划之类的文件。

segments.text: Super important is the emergency response plan.
segments.zh: 非常重要的是应急响应计划。

segments.text: This document's gonna be jam-packed with job and site-specific procedures for what to
segments.zh: 这份文件里会塞满针对具体岗位和场所的程序，告诉你

segments.text: do when stuff hits the fan.
segments.zh: 出了大事时该怎么做。

segments.text: It'll cover things from dealing with benchtop fires, spills, cuts, the whole shebang.
segments.zh: 它涵盖的内容包括处理台面火灾、泄漏、割伤，应有尽有。

segments.text: And finally, get up with your supervisor or safety officer.
segments.zh: 最后，去找你的主管或安全员。

segments.text: They're gonna want to drill you on a few things, like how to locate and use emergency
segments.zh: 他们会想就一些事情对你进行演练，比如怎样找到和使用应急

segments.text: eyewash stations, safety showers, fire blankets, and extinguishers.
segments.zh: 洗眼器、安全淋浴、灭火毯和灭火器。

segments.text: You know, stuff like that to deal with foreseeable emergencies.
segments.zh: 你知道的，就是这类应对可预见紧急情况的东西。

segments.text: We don't want to be in those types of situations, but better to be ready.
segments.zh: 我们都不希望遇到那种情况，但最好还是做好准备。

segments.text: Am I right?
segments.zh: 我说得对吧？
